question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. ABROGATE
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Repeal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"abrogate"** means to formally abolish or repeal a law, agreement, or custom. (निरस्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to abrogate the outdated trade agreement.
 
 
• The correct synonym of "abrogate" is **"repeal"**, which also means to officially cancel or revoke a law or regulation. (रद्द करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The parliament voted to repeal the controversial policy.
